title: ProcSense Terms and Conditions
status: Written by the project team in plain language. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer and it does not claim legal compliance (DT-127). The institution that gives you access completes the fields marked [institution].

sections.heading: What ProcSense is
paragraphs: ProcSense is an educational simulator for practising the pre-operative check in virtual reality and on a tablet. All patients, staff and records in it are invented. It is not a medical device, it gives no clinical advice and it must never be used to make a decision about a real patient.

sections.heading: Using your account
paragraphs: Use your own account and keep your password private. Do not enter real patient information, your own health information or anyone else's personal information into the simulator, whether by typing or by speaking. Do not try to disrupt the service or to reach other people's data.

sections.heading: What the AI does
paragraphs: Parts of the simulator use artificial intelligence to understand what you say and to write what the patient says. It can be wrong or unnatural. The simulator's rules, not the AI, decide what happened in the scenario and how you are scored. Do not treat anything the AI says as medical advice.

sections.heading: Your results
paragraphs: What you do in the simulator is stored, scored and shown to the supervisors and administrators of your organisation, as described in the Privacy Notice. Accepting these Terms lets you use ProcSense; it is not your consent to any optional use of your data. Optional uses, such as cloud AI processing and research, are separate choices that you make on their own.

sections.heading: Availability and changes
paragraphs: ProcSense is provided as it is, without a promise that it will always be available or free of mistakes. We may change the service or these Terms; when they change you are asked to agree again.
